Host: secure-login.microsoftech-support.com

Content-Length: 52
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64)

indicators: Email DKIM fail, SPF fail with mismatched domain
Unusual SMTP originating IP: 198.51.100.25 (not corporate infrastructure)
URL contains JWT-like session token parameter
Access logs showing legitimate user agent but unusual referrer '-' for login page
examples.detection_method: Email gateway flagged DKIM and SPF failures, heuristic anti-phishing detection based on domain similarity and URL structure; web proxy alert on access to unknown domain with credential POST; endpoint detection on suspicious outbound HTTPS traffic to new domain; user-reported phishing simulation failure.
